trust_decision.summary: The echarts tooltip is raw HTML (`renderMode: "html"`): anything a formatter interpolates from registry/recorder data (statistic label, entity friendly name, device/area/manufacturer/model, unit) is parsed as markup, so it must be escaped where the tooltip string is assembled. At this commit the only shared guard is `filterXSS` on the series name inside `ha-chart-base._getSeries`, and the Statistics Graph Card tooltip concatenates `param.seriesName` straight into its HTML string, so it is safe only while that guard runs - and the guard is skipped for the `sampling: "minmax"` line series the statistics card always creates.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the Statistics Graph Card; this is the only line in that card that pastes a data-derived name (`param.seriesName`) into the tooltip HTML string.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The series name is already run through `filterXSS` in the shared chart base (`ha-chart-base.ts:991`), so the Statistics Graph Card tooltip can be treated as inheriting a sanitised name; the other tooltip formatters sit in unrelated chart/page components (sankey, sunburst, history, energy, bluetooth/zha/zwave) that each look after their own escaping, so a fix scoped to the reported card looks complete.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
Tooltips are deliberately rich HTML that must keep rendering: echarts' own `params.marker` coloured span, `` labels, `

` titles, `
` separators and `
` value wrappers, plus an RTL marker for Arabic/Hebrew locales; on mobile the base chart also mutates `tooltip.confine/appendTo/triggerOn` in place on the caller's options object, which callers cache with memoizeOne. A blanket escape of the whole formatter output (or a filterXSS over the assembled string) kills the marker and the layout, and rewriting the caller's options in place pollutes the memoised object across chart instances.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: `_createOptions()` spreads `...this.options` after `chartOptions.series = this._getSeries()`, so a series/option contributed through `.options` overrides the processed ones and never sees the tooltip wrapping; cards already hand whole ECOption objects to this element, so a maintainer adding an option there is natural.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another custom-series chart (e.g. a new history/statistics variant) whose tooltip interpolates `name`/`seriesName` taken from user-set entity names
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Charts here are added one component at a time and each owns its own formatter; this file is exactly that pattern, with the tooltip built from `stateInfo.name`/`names[entity_id]`.
